description: Trim silence. Cut the silence at the start and the end of a recording. Pauses inside are left alone — in speech they carry meaning. Accepts audio/*, .m4a, .opus, .aac; up to 200 MB per file.

keepMs.description: How much silence to leave at the edges, in milliseconds

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

thresholdDb.description: What counts as silence, in dB. Quieter than this is cut

name: audio_silence-trim
